clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, Karos Razok keeps the Forsaken bat roost ready.

Karos Razok tends the skeletal bats from the wooden platform above the Sepulcher's crypts. Moonrage worgen, rogue Dalaran magi, and the human remnants of Ambermill make the northern road through Silverpine Forest treacherous. Razok keeps messengers, fresh recruits, and vital supplies moving above the haunted canopy, linking the frontier outpost to the capital in Tirisfal Glades.
